cooldown.decision: temperature at or below threshold before measured work

gemma_proportional_rope_validation.reference: unchanged host apply_gemma4_rope_in_place on the same real normalized Q/K activations; exponent denominator is head_dim and unrotated tail is copied unchanged

unrotated_channels.contract: exact pass-through, including channels on both partial-pair boundaries

mlp_region_validation.reference: unchanged host pre-FF RMSNorm -> MLP -> post-FF RMSNorm -> residual-add sequence on the same captured attention residuals

model.weight_format: source BF16 safetensors, resident text decoder

preflight.decision: accepted: service is not running (inactive or failed) and amd-smi reported no R9700 process
preflight.note: The required pgrep command was executed. Its raw output is deliberately summarized because its broad pattern can match an orchestration prompt rather than an executable workload; amd-smi process state is the authoritative R9700 occupancy check.

actual_runtimebuffer_accounting.scope_note: RuntimeBuffer accounting excludes HIP context/allocator overhead. amd-smi telemetry is captured while the resident allocation is live.

timing.clock: std::time::Instant monotonic wall clock; no profiler range is used as throughput

attention_region.units: nanoseconds measured with std::time::Instant; complete resident attention region including its final synchronization

host_profile.units: nanoseconds measured with std::time::Instant; primitive_ns is inclusive

workload.method: one cold-cache prefill only; no warmup or decode is included
